Uncredited (Bengali) |composername={{wp|Vishal–Shekhar|Vishal and Sheykhar}} |lyricistname={{wp|Rashmi Virag}} |colorscheme=Paldea }} '''Let's Get Started''' (Hindi: '''लेट्स गेट स्टार्टेड''' ''Let's Get Started'', Tamil: '''லெட்ஸ் கெட் ஸ்டார்டெட்''' ''Let's Get Started'', Telugu: '''లెట్స్ గెట్ స్టార్టెడ్''' ''Let's Get Started'', Bengali: '''লেটস গেট স্টারটেড''' ''Let's Get Started'') is the opening theme for the {{pmin|South Asia|Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Bengali}} dubs of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. It was used from ''[[HZ002|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two)]]'', replacing {{so|Gotta Catch Em All}}. [[Boom Kaboom]] is used as the corresponding ending theme. The opening animation has multiple versions that use the same footage as the corresponding English opening themes, [[Becoming Me]] and [[My Favorite Pokémon]] (which thmeselves use clips from the corresponding Japanese opening themes, [[Heart-Pounding Diary]], [[Halo]], and {{so|Will}}). The song was composed by the Indian music duo {{wp|Vishal–Shekhar|Vishal–Sheykhar}} with lyrics by the duo {{wp|Rashmi Virag|Rashmi–Virag}}, and vocals by singer {{wp|Armaan Malik}} in the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu versions, and by uncredited artists in the Bengali versions. The song was first unveiled at a press conference announcing the premiere of {{OBP|Pokémon Horizons: The Series|season}}[https://www.mediainfoline.com/entertainment/new-pokemon-show-pokemon-horizons-the-series-premieres-on-hungama-this-may-25th New Pokémon Show “Pokémon Horizons: The Series” Premieres on Hungama this May 25th - Media Infoline] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20240502032037/https://www.mediainfoline.com/entertainment/new-pokemon-show-pokemon-horizons-the-series-premieres-on-hungama-this-may-25th archived]). A [https://www.youtu.be/8Zv0aVgV8Dw music video] of the full version of the song was uploaded to the Disney India [[YouTube]] channel on May 24, 2024, and a sing-along video was uploaded to the official Pokémon YouTube channels on December 5, 2025. ==Opening animation== ===Version 1 ([[HZ001]] - [[HZ025]])=== ====Synopsis==== [[Liko]] holds her pendant before letting go, causing it to glow brightly as the camera zooms out. [[Roy]] holds one of the ancient adventurer's Poké Balls, gazing up at the clear sky surrounded by clouds. Liko and Roy lay down on the battlefield, exhausted as {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} and {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} come to their sides and they exchange a laugh. [[Mollie]] is in the nursery with {{TP|Mollie|Chansey}}, {{DL|Rising Volt Tacklers|Pawmi}}, {{DL|Rising Volt Tacklers|Shuckle}}, {{DL|Rising Volt Tacklers|Snorunt}}, and {{DL|Rising Volt Tacklers|Alolan Muk}}, turning around in her chair as Chansey carries a tray to the opposite end of the room. In the kitchen, [[Murdock]]'s {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}} fills a bowl with cream as Murdock and {{TP|Murdock|Rockruff}} are ready to make something out of it. [[Friede]] enters the Captain's deck to check on [[Captain Pikachu]] and {{TP|Friede|Charizard}}. In one of her videos, [[Dot|Nidothing]] and {{TP|Dot|Quaxly}} dance and get up close to the camera. Charizard and Cap watch as [[Amethio]] orders {{TP|Amethio|Ceruledge}} to attack while Liko and Sprigatito clash with Roy and Fuecoco. Liko and Sprigatito are shown together outside the observation room, enjoying the breeze. The logo appears in front of all the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] walking together ahead of the [[Brave Olivine]]. ====Characters==== * [[Liko]] * [[Roy]] * [[Mollie]] * [[Murdock]] * [[Friede]] * [[Dot|Nidothing]] * [[Amethio]] * [[Orla]] * [[Ludlow]] ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Sprigatito}} ({{OP|Liko|Sprigatito}}) * {{p|Fuecoco}} ({{OP|Roy|Fuecoco}}) * {{p|Chansey}} ({{OP|Mollie|Chansey}}) * {{p|Pawmi}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Shuckle}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Snorunt}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Muk}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]'; [[Alolan form]]) * {{p|Rockruff}} ({{OP|Murdock|Rockruff}}) * {{p|Alcremie}} ({{OP|Murdock|Alcremie}}; {{form|Alcremie|Strawberry Ruby Swirl}}) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Friede|Charizard}}) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Friede]]'s; [[Captain Pikachu]]) * {{p|Quaxly}} ([[Dot's Quaxly|Nidothing's]]) * {{p|Ceruledge}} ({{OP|Amethio|Ceruledge}}) * {{p|Metagross}} ([[Orla]]'s) ===Version 2 ([[HZ026]] - [[HZ045]])=== [[File:HZ OPE01 V2.png|thumb|250px|Second version of Let's Get Started]] ====Synopsis==== The black background is lit up as [[Liko]]'s pendant floats down between her hands. Young Liko walks behind her parents through a market as the memory turns gray. In the present, Liko's look of uncertainty is lifted as she turns to look up at the night sky. On a dirt road, a dirtied [[Roy]] gazes at his [[Ancient Poké Ball]] before confidently looking to the sky. Transitions with lines showing off the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] and their Pokémon occur, with [[Orla]], {{TP|Orla|Metagross}}, and {{TP|Orla|Elekid}}, [[Mollie]] and {{TP|Mollie|Chansey}}, [[Dot]] and {{TP|Dot|Quaxly}}, [[Murdock]], {{TP|Murdock|Rockruff}}, and {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}}, [[Ludlow]] and {{TP|Ludlow|Quagsire}}, and finally [[Captain Pikachu]] in the captain's chair as [[Friede]] steers the airship. The scene changes to show the [[Black Rayquaza]] flying alongside the Brave Olivine as {{an|Terapagos}}, {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}, Liko, {{TP|Roy|Wattrel}}, {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}}, and Roy run on its back. The final shot shows the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]' hands doing their trademark handshake below the bright sun as the logo appears. ====Characters==== * [[Liko]] * [[Roy]] * [[Friede]] * [[Mollie]] * [[Orla]] * [[Ludlow]] * [[Murdock]] * [[Dot]] * [[Alex]] * [[Lucca]] ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Sprigatito}} ({{OP|Liko|Sprigatito}}) * {{p|Hatenna}} ({{OP|Liko|Hatenna}} * {{p|Fuecoco}} ({{OP|Roy|Fuecoco}}) * {{p|Wattrel}} ({{OP|Roy|Wattrel}}) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Friede]]'s; [[Captain Pikachu]]) * {{p|Chansey}} ({{OP|Mollie|Chansey}}) * {{p|Metagross}} ([[Orla]]'s) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Orla]]'s) * {{p|Rockruff}} ({{OP|Murdock|Rockruff}}) * {{p|Alcremie}} ({{OP|Murdock|Alcremie}}; {{form|Alcremie|Strawberry Ruby Swirl}}) * {{p|Quaxly}} ({{OP|Dot|Quaxly}}) * {{p|Quagsire}} ([[Ludlow]]'s) * {{p|Terapagos}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Rayquaza}} ([[Black Rayquaza|Shiny]]) ===Version 3 ([[HZ046]] - [[HZ067]])=== {{incomplete|section}} [[File:HZ OPE02.png|thumb|250px|Third version of Let's Get Started]] ==Lyrics== ===Hindi=== ====TV version==== {{Schemetable|Paldea}} ! हिन्दी !
